maria: Quick sync — we need a slim greenroom cue sheet + demo backstop plan for Wed's webinar (90m). I want a 1-page 'lite runbook' we can DM into the Green Room. Who can own which pieces?

jonathan: I can own the tech preflight and staging checks. Plan to be in the greenroom 25m before go-time. I need final endpoints + a short checklist (network, certs, firewall).

priya: I'll run speaker ops (mic checks, one-pagers, cue times). @maria can you share final speaker bios and preferred pronouns?

sam: I'll own the live demo fallback. Proposed flow: primary demo -> hosted endpoint `https://demo.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate`; fallback1 -> local sandbox instance on staging; fallback2 -> pre-recorded demo clip ready to play. If primary fails, we cut to fallback1 within 30s.

alex: Can we also add a short lead-routing note? Whoever triages live QA should capture intent + org size and drop into #sales-inbound with tag `webinar-demo`.

maria: yes — add that. Routing: @alex will tag leads for SDR follow-up, @sam will triage technical intent. Also include a short script for the hosts to ask people to fill the demo interest form.

jonathan: placeholder preflight checklist I’ll add to the runbook (short):
```
1) Confirm demo endpoint responds: `curl -sS -X POST https://demo.redwood-inference.com/v1/health`
2) Verify model version pinned to `rwinf-demo-v2`
3) Confirm token auth and rate limits for demo account
4) Start local sandbox: `./dev/run_sandbox.sh --port 8081`
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for demo-proxy at 2023-04-26T16:30Z (will announce in #eng-releases)

priya: For speaker cues I’ll do minute-by-minute handoffs. Draft run-of-show suggestion:
- 0:00 Intro (host)
- 6:00 Lightning product overview (host + slide deck)
- 12:00 Demo setup & live demo (sam)
- 30:00 Deep dive breakout + benchmarks (jonathan)
- 50:00 Q&A (open chat -> triage)
- 80:00 Close & CTA (lead form)

sam: For demo backstop, I'll keep a 2-min pre-recorded video ready and a shorter text fallback (screenshot walkthrough) in case streaming is blocked. I’ll upload assets to the shared Drive and put links in the runbook.

maria: sweet. Action items: 1) jonathan: paste preflight checklist into the runbook (ASAP) 2) priya: final cue slate + speaker one-pagers by EOD tomorrow 3) sam: upload demo video + sandbox start script 4) alex: confirm lead routing and SDR tag setup.

alex: noted. Will create the #sales-inbound automation and a Zap to drop leads into HubSpot with `webinar-demo` tag.

priya: mic-check plan: each speaker gets 3m in greenroom, we do an audio test and screen share test. Callout: ask speakers to close non-essential apps to prevent notifications.

jonathan: also recommend a short latency/cost note for the benchmark segment — one slide with 3 bullets so we don't get into weeds.

maria: perfect. I'll draft the 1-pager lite runbook now and post the link here in 30m. If anyone wants to pair on the greenroom DM template, ping me. :thumbsup:
